notes.title: Patch Notes for Dec 29th 2021
notes.notes: General bug fixes and difficulty balancing. If you had trouble with the bomb boss at the end of the 2nd level you'll find her much easier to deal with now!

notes.title: Update Notes For August 6th Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that meant the game would crash if you pressed 'A' on a controller while picking up a healing pellet
Fixed some texture issues in the 4th level
